cargo-features = ["trim-paths"]
[package]
workspace = "../../../../.."
name = "semio-framework-surface"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
rust-version.workspace = true
description = "Surface family — paint, board-2d, terrain, node-graph, tiled-map rendering sessions as one wasm-bindgen crate"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "framework"

[lints]
workspace = true

[features]
default = ["session-bindgen"]
# 🌉️ wasm-bindgen session wrappers (Map/Terrain/…) — disabled when this file is path-mounted into
# infinite (avoids duplicate TerrainSession symbols linking surface+infinite into one cdylib).
session-bindgen = []

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.dev]
wasm-opt = false

[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.release]
wasm-opt = false

# 🪶️ REDUCE-DEMONSTRATOR-IDLE-MEMORY-FOOTPRINT. Applies when 📜️script.ts builds with wasm-pack
# `--profile wasm-release` (wasm-pack 0.15+ maps any custom profile name to this `custom` section,
# ignoring `profile.release` above). Runs after wasm-bindgen, mirroring os-dev's plugin -Oz post-pass
# (WASM_OPT_ARGS) minus `--low-memory-unused`: this module's stack-first memory layout means the
# "low 1KB is unused" assumption binaryen makes for that flag is unverified here.
[package.metadata.wasm-pack.profile.custom]
wasm-opt = ["-Oz", "--strip-debug", "--strip-producers", "--enable-bulk-memory", "--enable-bulk-memory-opt", "--enable-call-indirect-overlong", "--enable-extended-const", "--enable-multivalue", "--enable-mutable-globals", "--enable-nontrapping-float-to-int", "--enable-reference-types", "--enable-sign-ext"]

[lib]
crate-type = ["rlib", "cdylib"]
path = "🦀️.rs"

[dependencies]
semio-framework-pack-json = { path = "../../../🎒️pack/🔤️json/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-artifact-infinite-dag = { workspace = true }
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true }
ui_styling = { path = "../../../🖱️ui/🎨️styling/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-ui-styling" }
infinite_canvas = { path = "../../../../🛍️products/💻️os/🔨️modules/♾️infinite/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-infinite" }
semio-framework-os-kernel = { path = "../../../../🛍️products/💻️os/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-kernel" }
semio-framework-job = { workspace = true }
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"
image = { version = "0.25", default-features = false, features = ["png"] }
# 🏔️ Required by the path-mounted `🏔️terrain/🦀️.rs` above, which decodes Terrarium RGB-encoded
# elevation PNGs via the first-party codec (no third-party runtime dependency) instead of `image`.
# RUNTIME-DEPENDENCY-ELIMINATION-FOR-S-PLUGINS-AND-ARTIFACTS (26/09/01).
semio-framework-pixels = { path = "../../../🔲️pixels/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-pixels" }

# 🌉️ Browser-only `wasm_bridge` session wrappers (Terrain/NodeGraph/TiledMap/Paint — each wraps a
# pure `*Core` type that stays target-neutral). Excluded from `wasm32-wasip2` because
# `target_arch = "wasm32"` is TRUE for the WASI component target too — the wasip2 guest never
# attaches an `HtmlCanvasElement`, so it needs none of this bridge.
[target.'cfg(all(target_arch = "wasm32", not(target_env = "p2")))'.dependencies]
js-sys = "0.3.83"
wasm-bindgen = "0.2.106"
web-sys = { version = "0.3.98", features = ["HtmlCanvasElement", "Window"] }

# 🗺️ Cargo derives an integration test's crate name from its file stem, and a crate name may only
# contain ASCII — so the repo's emoji filename convention needs an explicit name/path pair here.
[[test]]
name = "tiled_map_mercator_oracle"
path = "../../🧪️tests/🗺️tiled-map-mercator-oracle/🦀️.rs"
observations.inverse:

semio-framework-actor = { workspace = true }

# tokio itself stays OWNED by `semio-framework-os-services` (the ticket's binding tokio-routing

wasmtime-wasi = "47.0.3"
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"

semio-framework-hash = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/🔏️hash/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../../../../../🔨️modules/⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
# 🧪️ MICROKERNEL-POOLED-ACTOR-PLUGIN-RUNTIME (terra-effects-async): `testkit` (unions with the

# same pattern `semio-framework-os-services`'s own Cargo.toml already establishes.
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true, features = ["testkit"] }

# 🚪️ `semio-framework-3d` dependency REMOVED (ticket 26/08/12/DISSOLVE-KERNELS-AND-MODULES-INTO-EVENT-SOURCED-ARTIFACTS
# wave IO1): the only references to it in this crate were `register_solid_exporter`/`register_solid_importer`
# and their supporting registry (`//#region SolidMediaExport`, `🖥️host/🦀️.rs`), deleted this same

# (`backbone`, `instance`, `media_export_raster`, `media_export_simple`, `workflow`) now use the
# first-party, byte-exact `semio-framework-io-base64` codec instead — base64 encode/decode is
# target-neutral pure computation, so it needed re-pointing, not a target-gate, matching
# os-kernel's proven `pack_value_to_base64`/`pack_value_from_base64` fix

semio-framework-pixels = { path = "../../../../../🔨️modules/🔲️pixels/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
resvg = "0.45.1"
tiny-skia = "0.11.4"
usvg = "0.45.1"
# 🗜️ `semio-framework-deflate` (its first-party `zip_archive`) is optional: its only production consumer is
# `🔨️modules/🪐️space/🦀️.rs`'s `//#region 🔖️Zip` (`export_collection_zip`/`import_collection_zip`
# and their `ZipStoreBridge`), which builds a portable `.zip` byte stream from caller-injected,
# already-in-memory bytes — zero ambient filesystem access, but genuinely host-only: it has no
# production caller anywhere in the repo today (its own docstring names its intended consumer as
# "a live `store::SpaceHost`'s registered members, W4's storage wave", a native host construct),
# and a WASI guest component has no reason to bundle its own export archive format. Same proof
# shape as `os-kernel`'s `os_extension` module (`os-kernel-host-crates-split.md`): `target_arch =

[target.'cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))'.dependencies]
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["sync"], default-features = false }

# on the plugin-host runtime AT ALL before this packet, which is exactly why "native smoke" (33/33
# via `semio-framework-os-run`) exercised a code path the product does not use — `🎠️activation/🦀️.rs`'s

semio-framework-async = { workspace = true }

[dev-dependencies]
png = "0.17.16"
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../../../🔨️modules/⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }

os-host-full = ["space-guest", "dep:semio-framework-deflate", "semio-framework-os-kernel/sync"]

workspace = true

# same-named features one level up, which forward into these.
sqlite = ["dep:rusqlite"]
postgres = ["dep:sqlx", "dep:tokio"]
neo4j = ["dep:neo4rs", "dep:tokio"]
# 🗝️ The claimed-shared-server test support (`db_storage::claimed_backend`) for OTHER crates' live laws (the hub's
# directory lanes): never in a runtime build, only in their `[dev-dependencies]`.
claimed-backend-laws = []

[dependencies]
semio-framework-diagnostic = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/⚠️diagnostic/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-value = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🌱️value/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-os-kernel = { path = "../../../../📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-kernel" }
semio-framework-replication = { workspace = true }
# 🔌️ `db_storage`'s schema-first task family crosses the sync/async boundary through the
# process-wide `WorkerPool` I/O lane; `FsStorage`/`db_storage_sqlite::SqliteStorage` dispatch
# their typed, retained operations there, and
# this crate names no concrete executor (no `tokio`, no `futures`) anywhere EXCEPT the one bounded
# runtime `db_storage_driver_runtime` owns for the external drivers that are bound to one — see that
# module's doc and `db_storage::DbIoAsyncDriverRuntime`. See `db_storage`'s module doc ("Async-first").
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true }
# 🔌️ Phase 1 (`26/08/20/INTERACTIVE-JOB-RUNTIME-REFACTOR`): `db_storage`'s blocking bridge submits
# to the process-wide `WorkerPool` on `Lane::Io` and reports its queue depth through this crate's
# `QueueCounter` for the Phase 1 exit gate. Workspace-internal, not a new third-party dependency.
semio-framework-trace = { workspace = true }
serde = { version = "1.0.219", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.140"
semio-framework-hash = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🔏️hash/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
[target.'cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))'.dependencies]
rusqlite = { version = "0.38.0", features = ["blob", "bundled"], optional = true }
# 🔌️ Same `sqlx-core`/`sqlx-postgres` major version `🌎️hub/📦️packages/🦀️rust/Cargo.toml` pins for its
# own directory backend, so the workspace resolves one `sqlx` line, not two. `runtime-tokio`
# selects sqlx's internal executor binding at ITS compile time — it does not require this crate to
# depend on `tokio` for its own sake. It does need one at RUNTIME: `sqlx` demands its runtime's
# thread-local context at poll time, and `db_storage`'s async-native drivers are dispatched from
# `Lane::Io` of the tokio-free `WorkerPool`, so the futures are polled on the bounded runtime
# `db_storage_driver_runtime` owns and never on a pool worker (measured abort: ticket 26/09/18 D4).
sqlx = { version = "0.8", default-features = false, features = ["runtime-tokio", "tls-rustls", "postgres"], optional = true }
neo4rs = { version = "0.8", optional = true }
# 🧵️ ONLY for `db_storage_driver_runtime` — the bounded, never-shut-down runtime the `sqlx`/`neo4rs`
# drivers above are polled on, behind `db_storage::DbIoAsyncDriverRuntime`. Enabled exactly by the
# `postgres`/`neo4j` features, i.e. only when a driver that requires one is actually linked. `rt`
# + `rt-multi-thread` build it, `net`/`time` give the drivers their reactor and timers.
tokio = { workspace = true, features = ["rt", "rt-multi-thread", "net", "time"], optional = true }

[dev-dependencies]
semio-framework-os-kernel = { path = "../../../../📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-os-kernel", features = ["durable-group-testing"] }
# 🎒️ Renamed on purpose: this package's lib target is named `pack`, and cargo derives a dependency's
# extern name from the LIB name unless the dependency key renames it — so plain
# `semio-framework-pack` arrives as `pack`, which this crate has already bound to the os-kernel
# (`extern crate semio_framework_os_kernel as pack`). The key then loses and `🦀️.rs`'s
# `pub use semio_framework_pack::corruption_testing` stops resolving, taking the whole test target
# with it. Naming the key `semio_framework_pack` is what makes cargo rename it.
semio_framework_pack = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/🎒️pack/📦️packages/🦀️rust", package = "semio-framework-pack", features = ["corruption-testing"] }
semio-framework-async-macros = { path = "../../../../../../🔨️modules/⏳️async/✨️macros/📦️packages/🦀️rust" }
semio-framework-async = { workspace = true, features = ["testkit"] }
